## 🏢 About

**HH Auto Repair** is a professional vehicle repair and MOT testing garage located in Bicester, Oxfordshire. We provide honest, expert automotive services with clear pricing and fast turnaround.

---

## ⚙️ Services

| Service | Details |
|---|---|
| 🔍 **MOT Testing** | Classes 4, 5 & 7 — DVSA Authorised Station |
| 🔧 **Mechanical Repairs** | Full mechanical diagnostics & repairs |
| 🚗 **Bodywork** | Dents, scratches & body panel repairs |
| 📡 **Diagnostics** | Latest OBD scan tools, same-day service |
